$comment: The memory store. Each memory names the turn it came from (source turn:...), when it was true and when it must be revalidated. The producer suppresses expired memories and reports them without their body (R-14). It filters by tenant only, so a memory of another user of the same tenant reaches admission, which excludes it as out_of_scope: the producer's leak, the assembler's catch.
